question: Which valuation is adopted for fire code tax computation if a building owner's cost estimate differs from Table II.G.1 of PD 1096?
answer: If a building owner's cost estimate differs from Table II.G.1 of PD 1096 for fire code tax computation, the valuation that will be adopted is the one from current acceptable market construction cost per square meter as indicated in Table II.G.1 of PD 1096, the higher the value will be adopted. [S1]

ground_truth: Under Section 8.3.6 of JMC 2021-01, if there is a substantial difference between the building cost declared by the owner and current market costs in Table II.G.1 of PD 1096, the higher value is adopted for computing fire construction taxes.
